items.question: How much notice is needed to terminate the Kestrel storage agreement?
items.answer: The Kestrel storage agreement requires sixty (60) days' written notice for termination. This is stated in the agreement, which says: "Either party may terminate this Agreement on sixty (60) days' written notice" [1].

evidence.quote: Either party may terminate this Agreement on sixty (60) days' written notice.

items.question: When did Jonas Ekberg say the chiller alarm sounded?
items.answer: The documents do not state when Jonas Ekberg said the chiller alarm sounded. They only state that he recalled the temperature alarm sounded at about 02:40 on 18 June 2026 [2].

items.question: What did the shift supervisor say about the Voss-Lindqvist pallets?
items.answer: The shift supervisor, Jonas Ekberg, stated that the Voss-Lindqvist pallets were moved to Hall 1 by 05:15 on the morning following the chiller failure [1].

evidence.quote: I remember that we had moved the Voss-Lindqvist pallets to Hall 1 by 05:15 that morning

items.question: When did Jonas Ekberg say the chiller was repaired?
items.answer: The documents do not state when Jonas Ekberg said the chiller was repaired. The source only mentions that he moved the Voss-Lindqvist pallets to Hall 1 by 05:15 on the morning after the chiller failure, but it does not specify when the chiller itself was repaired [3].
